thread:
people-ops: Heads up 0 quick handbook patch about offboarding data access: new checklist and a 10-15min mandatory "Offboarding & Data Access" ack for any employees or contractors who will be offboarded or change roles in the next 6 months. Deadline: 2026-08-15.

Links:
 Patch: https://handbook.redwood.ai/offboarding
 Module: https://learning.redwood.ai/courses/offboarding-data-ack
 Tracker: https://sheets.redwood.ai/people-ops/offboarding-ack-tracker

Managers: add folks leaving or changing roles to the tracker and confirm completion. Contractors with access keys are auto-enrolled. For staging-only vendors, request exemption in the tracker.

rebecca: If someone left last week, do they need to be added retroactively?

people-ops: Retroactive additions allowed for 30 days post-exit; attach evidence if you mark complete. We'll run an audit sample.

anil: Can recruiting mark offboarded contractors? They aren't in HRIS yet.

people-ops: Yes  add them manually to the tracker and include vendor contact info. We can ingest entries for compliance exports.

hrbot: Reminder set  "Offboarding & Data Access ack due" 2026-08-08 09:00 PDT. :bell:

sylvie: How long are these ack records kept?

people-ops: Retained 7 years per policy. For exports contact compliance@redwood.ai.

people-ops: We'll drop a short manager checklist and FAQ in this channel tomorrow. Ping for access issues. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
